summary: Implementation follows the sealed plan, but required relation rejection tests can pass for unrelated reasons. This leaves acceptance criterion 4 inadequately verified. Runtime tests could not be independently rerun because the available Python lacks Pydantic.

evidence: Read all of diff.patch and every changed file; compared changes with L07, plan.md and tree/loop/NORTH_STAR.md. Changes directly implement hypothesis sets and their private authoring path.
tests/test_competing_sets.py:149 persists the relation before the negative cases at lines 154–159 reuse its identity and revision; these assertions do not prove the required rejection behavior.
tests/test_competing_sets.py:156 tests observed status with empty evidence, so it cannot distinguish the new hypothesis-claim restriction from the existing evidence requirement.

Traced CompetingSet registration, schema version, exact member references, immediate predecessor validation, SQL reference persistence, submission linkage and snapshot traversal through domain.py, persistence.py, pilot_domain.py and pilot.py.
Inspected test_revision_admission_uses_exact_pins_and_retains_history and test_private_cli_draft_authoring_sessions_show_and_pinned_exports for pinned historical records.
Checked lint applicability: L12 introduces the future lint subsystem; the sealed plan explicitly excludes implementing it here.

test_relation_contract_and_no_inferred_edges contains masked negative assertions at tests/test_competing_sets.py:154–159; removing the new self-relation rejection would not make its self-relation cases fail.
Parsed all runtime Python modules and the new test module successfully. Supplied gate.json reports 249 passes, but independent execution was unavailable.

Checked added documentation, docstrings and CLI descriptions against implementation: residual structure, exact revision membership, retained constraints, directional refinement and absence of confidence arithmetic agree.
Independently recomputed the diff hash and all seven product hashes recorded in the report; all match.
Reviewed numeric confidence fixtures against explicit expected values None, 0.8, 0.9 and 0.95. New documentation makes no empirical completeness or causal-validity claim.
Compared all eight changed paths with the sealed plan's file list and verified the report's Plan section matches plan.md.
Inspected D01–D14 in tree/loop/backlog.toml; no deferred capability is introduced.
Checked the diff for I4, I10, I11 and I16 boundaries: no protected-file, dependency, existing-test or harness edits. Supplied gate.json also reports these checks passing.

blocking_findings.description: The relation rejection test first persists edge, then submits modified copies with the same ID and revision under a generic ValueError assertion. If the self-relation guard is removed, both self-relation cases still pass because Repository.put rejects the changed payload as an immutable revision conflict before checking links. Other cases share this masking risk. The observed-status case additionally uses empty evidence, so the pre-existing observed-relation evidence check rejects it even if the new predicates are omitted from the claims-only restriction. Thus these tests would remain green with required behavior broken.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Give each invalid candidate a fresh identity or test domain validation directly, and assert the intended validation error. Test observed status using otherwise valid, persisted evidence and valid endpoints. Verify that removing the self-relation guard or excluding either new predicate from the claims-only restriction makes the corresponding test fail.

loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Add tests that raise an unrelated error and count them as proof of the requested validation.
loophole_audit.evidence: tests/test_competing_sets.py:149-159 reuses a persisted revision; generic ValueError assertions mask missing relation validation. See F1.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 1: registered, persistable sets with valid pinned membership.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Store arbitrary member IDs without resolving their kinds, revisions or intent.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_single_named_member_and_supplied_residual and test_set_reference_boundaries_and_copy_revalidation exercise duplicates, wrong kinds, dangling revisions and cross-intent members. Invalid set candidates are not already persisted, avoiding the F1 masking problem.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 2: explicit flags and exactly one residual when exhaustive.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Always append a residual or silently coerce missing flags.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_flags_residual_and_claim_confidence_are_independent checks all four combinations against explicit member lists; test_flags_require_explicit_booleans rejects coercions and omissions; malformed-residual tests include otherwise valid named membership.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 3: residual is structural and does not create a substantive hypothesis.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Create a synthetic hypothesis carrying confidence or supported status.
loophole_audit.evidence: domain.py:308-311 defines only the residual kind and description. tests/test_competing_sets.py:74-84 checks exact serialization, unchanged hypothesis inventory and absent assessments.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 4: both relation kinds enforce endpoint and epistemic contracts.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Accept the predicates while letting unrelated persistence errors satisfy negative tests.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_relation_contract_and_no_inferred_edges proves positive persistence and direction, but its self-relation and observed-status rejection assertions are masked as described in F1.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 5: exclusivity in both admission orders, including concurrency.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Check exclusivity only in the CLI or only when adding a relation after a set.
loophole_audit.evidence: persistence.py:193-244 checks both admission paths inside the writer transaction. test_exclusivity_both_insertion_orders_and_endpoint_orders requires the exclusive-specific error; the concurrent test synchronizes admission and requires exactly one committed record.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 6: exact retained pins and append-only set revisions.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Consult only the latest set or silently replace old hypothesis pins.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_revision_admission_uses_exact_pins_and_retains_history checks retained exclusive constraints, non-inherited membership, rejected conflicting revisions and unchanged old bytes. domain.py:334-336 explicitly requires the immediate predecessor.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 7: confidence remains claim-local and missing evidence produces no verdict.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Normalize member confidence or assign the residual its complement.
loophole_audit.evidence: tests/test_competing_sets.py:69-84 checks explicit independent values and unchanged hypotheses; domain.py:314-319 has no set confidence field. CLI integration asserts UNKNOWN.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 8: private authoring, session linkage and pinned snapshot exports.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Persist an orphan set or export the latest hypotheses instead of the pinned records.
loophole_audit.evidence: test_private_cli_draft_authoring_sessions_show_and_pinned_exports checks draft rejection, CLI submission, session and author, show output, revision resolution, snapshot membership and unchanged earlier exports.

loophole_audit.criterion: Plan 9: deterministic serialization, compatibility and privacy.
loophole_audit.lazy_pass: Only compare an object with itself or expose private records through generic serialization.
loophole_audit.evidence: Tests reconstruct fixed-input sets, revalidate JSON and reopen the repository; explicit member lists and old field-name sets supplement round-trip comparisons. Inspected presentation.py's explicit public allowlist and test_public_embed_exclude_sets_and_old_payloads_have_no_new_defaults. No existing tests or protected outputs appear in the diff.

claims_for_research.claim: A static-camera regeneration is confounded by changes to the generated sample; multiple controlled replicates should be used instead of attributing causality to one improved clip. This is an existing methodological claim in unchanged context.
